$comment: A mapping claim a prose document (PDF, Word) actually states: THIS column is loaded from THAT column. Distinct from doc_description, which captures what a field MEANS — a design document does both and they are different claims with different evidence. One record per (target field, source field) pair, so n-1 is several records sharing one target_column. No datatypes: where a document states them it states them as prose, and a guessed type is worse than a missing one. target_table is nullable because a mapping table often names the target once in a caption and never again per row; unlike a workbook there is no sheet name to fall back on, so a null here is honest and the assembler records that the subject came from a cell.
